title: LineageDatasetFacet
description: QFF's declared dataset mapping. The dataset carrying this facet is the destination. This is not a recorded execution.

mapping.description: Copy matching fields by name, or flatten source preferences groups into the destination preferences array, copying item fields by name and supplying the kind.

resolveIdentity.description: Resolve the request's external_id to the destination's internal identity_id in addition to the declared payload mapping.

kindByGroup.description: Source group names under preferences and the destination kind for each group's items.
